summary.evaluation: 整体表现已经具备稳定的 Part 1 交流能力，能够自然展开回答，并且使用了 magical ability、low-key、oversharing、freaks me out、rant about life、bouncing between 等较地道的口语表达，词汇资源明显高于基础水平。主要失分点不是“没话说”，而是口语输出中的小语法错误、搭配不精准和 self-correction 较多，例如 people who don't、control myself for not scrolling、social medias、mostly are vlogs 等；如果能把这些高频小错压下去，整体表现有潜力稳定进入 7 分区间。
key_improvements: 重点消灭高频“小语法错误”，尤其是主谓一致、冠词、可数名词复数和介词搭配；这些错误单独看不严重，但连续出现会限制 Grammar Accuracy。
减少句子中途的重复和重启，例如 scroll scroll、we talked ab- we use、shorts con- shorts，以及 you can just share you can't just；可以用短暂停顿替代重新启动句子。
继续保持现在这种自然的口语词汇风格，但进一步升级固定搭配，例如 spend too much time on、stay connected、a go-to spot、be a fan of，而不是单纯堆高级单词。

quick_version.original: So, yeah, I remembered I liked her a lot back then
quick_version.corrected: So, yeah, I remember I liked her a lot back then.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I still remember how much I liked her back then.
quick_version.explanation: 这里是在回忆过去的经历，remember 后面直接接过去事实即可；I remembered 容易变成“我当时想起来了”。I still remember how much I liked her 更自然，也更有口语感。

quick_version.original: She made me not hate math which is the most important thing for me back then
quick_version.corrected: She made me not hate math, which was the most important thing for me back then.
quick_version.native_upgrade: She actually made me stop hating math, which was probably the biggest impact she had on me.
quick_version.explanation: 主句发生在过去，因此 which 后面用 was。make somebody not hate 虽然可以理解，但 stop hating math 更自然；biggest impact she had on me 还能增加表达层次。

quick_version.original: It would be fun to see if they remember me or not, but definitely I hope it's for good reason.
quick_version.corrected: It would be fun to see if they remember me or not, and I definitely hope it's for a good reason.
quick_version.native_upgrade: It'd be fun to find out whether they still remember me, hopefully for all the right reasons.
quick_version.explanation: for good reason 不是这里最自然的搭配；for a good reason 表示“出于一个好的理由”。不过如果想表达“希望他们记得我是因为好的事情”，all the right reasons 更地道。

quick_version.original: So I mostly just scroll scroll around but not post
quick_version.corrected: So I mostly just scroll around but don't post anything.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I'm mostly a passive user, so I tend to scroll through my feed rather than post anything myself.
quick_version.explanation: but 后面需要与前面的结构保持平行，don't post anything 比 but not post 更完整。scroll through my feed 是更自然的社交媒体搭配。

quick_version.original: But I do need to control myself a little bit for not scrolling too much
quick_version.corrected: But I do need to control myself a little bit so that I don't scroll too much.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I do have to exercise a bit of self-control to stop myself from endlessly scrolling.
quick_version.explanation: control myself for not doing 是不自然的介词结构。可以使用 so that I don't... 或 stop myself from doing...；exercise self-control 和 endlessly scrolling 属于更高级的自然搭配。

quick_version.original: I don't think I know anyone who don't use it.
quick_version.corrected: I don't think I know anyone who doesn't use it.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I honestly can't think of anyone I know who doesn't use social media.
quick_version.explanation: who 指代 anyone，视为第三人称单数，因此应该使用 doesn't。can't think of anyone who... 是非常自然的口语结构。

quick_version.original: We, um, I feel like we, talked ab- we, we use social media for everything
quick_version.corrected: I feel like we use social media for everything.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I feel like social media has become part of almost every aspect of our daily lives.
quick_version.explanation: 原句存在明显 self-correction 和重复。最终想表达的意思很清楚，但可以直接用一个完整句子输出；upgrade 使用 has become part of... 能显著提高句式和词汇质量。

quick_version.original: they post pictures, stock their favorite celebrities
quick_version.corrected: they post pictures, stalk their favorite celebrities
quick_version.native_upgrade: They post pictures, keep up with their favorite celebrities, rant about their lives, and watch funny videos.
quick_version.explanation: 如果这里的原始发音确实是 stock，那么正确单词应为 stalk；stalk 表示持续关注甚至跟踪某人。若实际想表达普通的“关注明星”，keep up with their favorite celebrities 更自然，也更符合社交媒体语境。

quick_version.original: I usually just visit website just for fun
quick_version.corrected: I usually just visit websites for fun.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I mostly browse websites for entertainment, especially when I want to unwind.
quick_version.explanation: website 是可数名词，泛指时应使用复数 websites；同时 just visit... just... 形成重复。browse websites for entertainment 和 unwind 更自然。

quick_version.original: tutorials on makeup and skincare routines. Yeah, mostly are vlogs
quick_version.corrected: tutorials on makeup and skincare routines. Yeah, they're mostly vlogs.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I mainly watch vlogs, along with the occasional makeup or skincare tutorial.
quick_version.explanation: mostly are vlogs 缺少主语；应该是 they're mostly vlogs。mainly watch vlogs, along with... 是更简洁、更自然的表达。

quick_version.original: I can spend hours on there just bouncing between coding tutorials, vlogs, and travel contents.
quick_version.corrected: I can spend hours on there just bouncing between coding tutorials, vlogs, and travel content.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I can easily lose track of time jumping between coding tutorials, travel vlogs, and other content.
quick_version.explanation: content 通常作为不可数名词使用，因此这里不需要 contents。lose track of time 是非常高频且自然的 IELTS 口语搭配。

quick_version.original: I've noticed more shorts videos popping up.
quick_version.corrected: I've noticed more short videos popping up.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I've noticed a growing number of short-form videos popping up on the platform.
quick_version.explanation: 如果表达普通的“短视频”，应该使用 short videos；short-form videos 是更精准、更高级的表达。原句中的 shorts 更像是特指 YouTube Shorts 这一产品名称。

quick_version.original: It feels like they're really pushing that TikTok vibes
quick_version.corrected: It feels like they're really pushing those TikTok vibes.
quick_version.native_upgrade: It feels like they're increasingly trying to emulate TikTok's style.
quick_version.explanation: vibes 是复数，因此不能使用 that。push TikTok vibes 属于口语化表达，而 emulate TikTok's style 更精准、更适合 7 分以上表达。

quick_version.original: which I'm not a really a fan of
quick_version.corrected: which I'm not really a fan of.
quick_version.native_upgrade: I'm not particularly a fan of that trend, to be honest.
quick_version.explanation: a really a fan 是冠词和副词位置重复。正确结构是 not really a fan of；not particularly a fan of 是更自然的正式口语表达。

quick_version.original: social medias like WeChat and RedNote are huge
quick_version.corrected: social media platforms like WeChat and RedNote are huge.
quick_version.native_upgrade: Social media platforms like WeChat and RedNote are hugely popular.
quick_version.explanation: social media 通常作为不可数名词使用，不说 social medias。这里实际上想表达的是“社交媒体平台”，因此 social media platforms 更精准；hugely popular 也比 huge 更完整。

quick_version.original: because you can just share you can't just, you know, stare at your phone all day without your boss noticing
quick_version.corrected: because you can use the web version without having to stare at your phone all day, so your boss won't notice.
quick_version.native_upgrade: People can use the web version at work without constantly looking down at their phones, so it's a discreet way to take a quick break without drawing attention from their bosses.
quick_version.explanation: 原句存在明显的 self-correction，can just share 与后面的 can't just 构成语义冲突，导致句子没有完成。discreet way to take a quick break 和 without drawing attention 是更地道的表达。

full_transcript.text: Good morning. My name is Laura, and I will be your examiner today. Let's start with a few questions about teachers. Do you have a favorite teacher?

Oh, yes, I do. I remember my high school math teacher, I think she was the best because she had this magical ability to make even the most confusing formulas make sense. So, yeah, [[err_1|I remembered I liked her a lot back then]]
Mm-hmm. In what way has your favourite teacher helped you?

Mm, I think she never made anyone feel dumb for asking questions and, um, you know um, specifically asking questions in front of other people. She made me not hate math [[err_2|which is the most important thing for me back then]]
Mmm. Mm. Right. Do you want to be a teacher in the future?

Not really, to be honest. I respect teachers a lot, of course, but I don't think teaching full-time is something I would want to do. It doesn't quit- [[err_3|it doesn't quite fit my personality or long-term goals]]
And are you still in touch with your primary school teachers?
Not really, but I kind of wish I was. It would be fun to see if they remember me or not, but definitely I hope [[err_4|it's for good reason]].
Mm-hmm
Thank you. Now let's talk about social media. Have you ever posted anything on social media?

Mm, no, honestly, I'm pretty low-key online. Um, and I feel like oversharing just freaks me out a little bit. Regarding, you know, personal privacy. So [[err_5|I mostly just scroll scroll around but not post]]
Mmm. When did you start using social media?
Probably when I was a teenager, I think my first account was on some old platform that isn't even active anymore
Mm-hmm.
Do you think you spend too much time on social media?

Mm, a hundred percent. But I try not to think about it too much. I tell myself it's all about staying connected. But I do need to um, you know, [[err_6|control myself a little bit for not scrolling too much]]
Mm-hmm.
And do your friends use social media?
Oh, definitely. I don't think I know anyone [[err_7|who don't use it]]. We, um, I feel like we, talked ab- we, we use social media for everything
Mm-hmm.
So what do people often do on social media?
Well, they post pictures, [[err_8|stock their favorite celebrities]], rant about life, watch funny videos, or sometimes even learn something useful. It's basically a bit of everything
Mm-hmm. Right.
Thanks. Now let's talk about websites. What kinds of websites do you often visit?
Oh, [[err_9|I usually just visit website just for fun]], you know, like YouTube for vlogs or TikToks for short videos, and tutorials on makeup and skincare routines. Yeah, [[err_10|mostly are vlogs]]
What is your favourite website?

Oh, definitely YouTube. I think I can spend hours on there just bouncing between coding tutorials, vlogs, and [[err_11|travel contents]]. Yeah, it's my go to spot for, you know, winding down after a long day
Mm-hmm. Are there any changes to the websites you often visit?

Yeah, for sure. Um, YouTube has definitely changed a lot. I've noticed more [[err_12|shorts videos]] popping up. Um, it feels like they're really pushing [[err_13|that TikTok vibes]], which [[err_14|I'm not a really a fan of]]
What kinds of websites are popular in your country?

Well, I would say [[err_15|social medias like WeChat and RedNote are huge]], especially their web version. A lot of people use the we- the web version at work because [[err_16|you can just share you can't just, you know, stare at your phone all day without your boss noticing]]. So it's like a sneaky way to take a quick break.
Mmm. Thank you. That ends part one.
